answer: Decaying guardian weights reduce a guardian's influence the longer it stays silent, and the karst of the design is that only recently active guardians carry full weight. The ledge of the mechanism is a decay curve published in advance, so everyone knows how weights change over time. A Sybil cannot accumulate power by creating old dormant guardians, because their weight has already decayed, and the copper of the decay rewards guardians who stay engaged with the owner.
